description: Send an SMS or WhatsApp message. For WhatsApp, prefix `To` (and `From`) with `whatsapp:+E164`. Supply either `From` (a Twilio phone number) OR `MessagingServiceSid` (a Messaging Service). If neither is given, falls back to env TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID.

From.description: Twilio phone number in E.164, or `whatsapp:+E164` for WhatsApp. Omit if using MessagingServiceSid.

MediaUrl.description: Optional list of media URLs (MMS / WhatsApp media)

MessagingServiceSid.description: Messaging Service SID (MG...). Overrides env default. Omit if using From.

StatusCallback.description: Webhook URL Twilio calls on delivery-status transitions

To.description: Destination in E.164 (e.g. +5511999999999) or `whatsapp:+E164` for WhatsApp

name: send_message
